integrity: A new analytical result about the published FPFM2 map. Original model and earlier related constructions credited explicitly; no claim of independent verification, peer-reviewed novelty, hardware testing or numerical exhaustiveness.
scientific_limitations: Only prime-period-two orbits of the exact real-plane FPFM2 map are classified; no longer-period or attractor-census claim.
Linear sink claims apply only where both ordinate coordinates are nonzero; the modulus kink is not differentiable.
The explicit instability statement covers the positive-ordinate branch, not the complete stability classification of negative-ordinate branches.
Finite high-precision checks supplement, but do not establish, the infinite analytic theorem.
Unindexed or unpublished earlier priority remains possible; independent mathematical audit is outstanding.
title: A locked two-cycle and a sharp persistence transition in an absolute-value memristor map
